# OPS-RBAC — Ontario Design System AI Catalog

Read AGENTS.md first.

## Project catalogs (single source of truth)

- Component list: docs/ods/COMPONENT-INDEX.md
- Component props: docs/ods/COMPONENT-API.md
- Design tokens: docs/ods/TOKENS.md
- Installed versions: docs/ods/VERSION.md

## Project constraints

- Stack: Vite + React 19 SPA
- Asset base path: /assets/
- Global styles: @ongov/ontario-design-system-global-styles/styles/css/compiled/ontario-theme.min.css (imported in src/main.tsx)
- Import components from @ongov/ontario-design-system-component-library-react
